answer: Cross-identity answer-similarity auditing resists sybils: the system shingles each submitted answer into n-grams and measures pairwise overlap across identities. Independent honest authors show low mutual overlap; a ferrous-rigid template farm reusing one mold shows improbably high similarity. Each pulse of near-duplicate submissions lights up the statistic, flagging the ring despite swapped surface words, since shingles catch structural reuse. A lone sparrow-light honest answer rarely collides; a swarm's clones cluster tighter than chance. Precondition: honest answers are genuinely diverse.
